onboarding.welcome_title: Never get caught off guard again.
onboarding.welcome_text: Phases follows her cycle and gives you a heads-up the day before the moments that matter.
onboarding.mode_partner_sub: I follow her cycle to show up at the right time
onboarding.reassure_local: Nothing leaves this phone. No account.
onboarding.reassure_medical: Not a medical tool, not birth control.
onboarding.last_period_partner: When did her last period start?
onboarding.last_period_self: When did your last period start?
onboarding.last_period_text: The first day is enough. A rough guess works: you can fix it later.
onboarding.dont_know_ask: I don't know, I'll ask her
onboarding.ask_message: Quick logistics question: what day did your last period start?
onboarding.reminders_title: We'll tell you the day before.
onboarding.reminders_text: Three reminders per cycle, never more. Change times or choices anytime.
onboarding.reminders_permission: iOS will ask for permission. If you say no, the app still works, without reminders.

today.late_text: Not confirmed yet. A few days off is common: the next dates wait for your confirmation.
today.irregular: Irregular cycle. Your recent cycles range from {{min}} to {{max}} days: dates are estimates.

notif.pms_body_partner: The next 7 days may be harder for her. Fewer debates, more kindness.
notif.pms_body_self: Your PMS likely starts tomorrow. Lighten your schedule if you can.
notif.period_body_partner: Hot water bottle, painkillers in the cabinet, a quiet evening. You'll confirm tomorrow.
notif.period_body_self: Keep what you need on you tomorrow.
notif.confirm_body: One tap to recalibrate the next dates.
notif.ovulation_body: The phase when energy and wanting to go out are often at their highest.

guide.title: The phases
guide.intro: A typical 28-day cycle. Hers may be shorter or longer.
guide.disclaimer: Every cycle is different. Phases estimates; only she knows.

settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Her first name
settings.erase_confirm: Erase everything? Cycles, settings and reminders will be deleted from this phone.

history.regular: Regular cycle: predictions accurate to ± 1 day.
history.swipe_hint: Swipe a row left to edit or delete it.

lock.title: Phases is locked
lock.text: Unlock to see where she's at.

sync.title: Sync
sync.text: Hold your phones together: scan with the camera and both apps are up to date.
sync.shared_text: Cycle start dates and lengths. Never your settings, your name or your notes.
sync.received_text: Received by link. Nothing went through a Phases server.

dev.clock_note: Notifications follow the iPhone's real day.
